originalRecipe.concept: A familiar honey mustard egg toasties meal for two, using its actual listed ingredients and one defined cooking route. Authored draft, not taste-tested.
originalRecipe.serve_and_store: Divide the finished meal evenly between two people. Refrigerate perishable leftovers in shallow covered containers at 40 F (4 C) or colder within 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90 F (32 C). Reheat leftovers to 165 F (74 C). No recipe-specific storage life or physical cooking has been tested.

steps.instruction: Beat whole egg with garlic powder, table salt in the raw-egg mixing bowl. Heat the allocated olive oil in the skillet over medium-low heat. Pour every portion of beaten egg into the skillet. Gently fold for about 3-5 minutes until firm curds form, no liquid egg remains and the center reaches 160 F (71 C). Transfer every cooked piece and its measured pan juices to the clean heatproof filling bowl. Keep this bowl separate from raw-food utensils.

Return all cooked whole egg from the clean heatproof filling bowl to the skillet. Take the skillet off the heat. Scrape all cooked filling into the clean heatproof filling bowl. The skillet is now empty for the bread step. Toast all four bread slices in the toaster in two batches. Combine all ready-made Dijon mustard, honey with the hot filling in the clean bowl. Divide the complete filling between two toast sandwiches. Use no extra butter or spread.

originalRecipe.timing_note: Estimated 30-50 minutes elapsed and 25-45 minutes active/attention-bound, including filling and two sequential sandwich batches. Not kitchen timed.

Whisk the allocated egg and salt. Pour half into the nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Add half the allocated cheese, fold and cover until firm, no liquid egg remains and the center reaches 160 F (71 C). Transfer to a serving plate and repeat with all remaining egg and cheese. Toast all four bread slices in two toaster batches. Divide all cooked egg filling and toast between two portions.
